author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE. Looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. Send PROFESSIONAL email to whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with name, location, position, resume/portfolio, rates per panel, turnaround, software, payment method. NO DEADLINE, ROLLING. NO AI.

author: dimension11studios
title: Hiring Character Artist for Legends of Orisha
content: WE'RE HIRING! Looking for a Character Artist for Legends of Orisha: Blood and Water. Skilled in 3D character modelling, sculpting, texturing, and Unreal Engine. Experience with MetaHuman, realistic 4C hair, African hairstyles a plus. Remote. Long-term. Full job description and application via link in bio.

author: dinsai.studio
title: Hiring 2D Concept Artist (Contract)

author: creativeleadscommunity
title: Line Art Finishing Artist for Graphic Novel
